name: BYOM-incompatible endpoints (rollup)
summary: Endpoints whose model parameter is NOT routed through gateway connections: embeddings, TTS, STT, fine-tuning, batch, realtime (WebSocket).
description: Embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, fine-tuning, Batch, and Realtime WebSocket endpoints use endpoint-specific deployment selection instead of the Foundry Responses BYOM prefix. The user problem is knowing which model-bearing APIs still require a local Azure OpenAI/Foundry deployment instead of an APIM AI Gateway connection.
notes:
Not every endpoint in this rollup has a dedicated Foundry probe yet. See `batch-api` for concrete `/batches` proof and `realtime-transcription` / `realtime-translation` for the Realtime model-slot analysis.

No documented BYOM route exists for the remaining endpoint-specific deployment slots; split any endpoint into its own card if it gains support.
